newsitem.title: PANAMA: Three firms eye Panama convention center.
newsitem.headline: Three firms eye Panama convention center.

text.p: Three international firms are considering bidding to operate the nation's only convention center in Panama City, a top government official said Thursday.
Panama closed the pre-qualification process to operate the seaside Atlantico-Pacifico (ATLAPA) convention center, Cesar Tribaldos, head of Panama's Tourism Institute, told reporters.
Presenting documents were Spanish hotel chain Sol Melia and U.S. companies Carnival Corp and Casino America Inc, he said.
The concession contract includes an option to build a five star hotel with casino on 15 acres (six hectares) of land across the street from the 14,000 square-meter center, he said.
The government plans to announce the qualifying companies in 30 days. A public bid is scheduled for October with construction to begin by the end of the year, he said.
